primitives.name: Movement Metric
primitives.verbatim_quote: **`packages/prediction-engine/src/tracking/cv-movement-primitive.ts`** — math + data contracts for broadcast-video-derived tracking: `FramePoint`/`Tracklet`/`MovementMetric` contracts, camera motion estimation via dominant-displacement compensation, homography fit from yardlines (pixels → field meters; field 120×53.3 yd = 109.7×48.8 m), perspective transform, per-player speed/distance derivation, ball interpolation across dropped frames.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'p_i': 'player index, dimensionless', 't': 'time, seconds', '\\Delta x': 'change in x-position, meters', '\\Delta y': 'change in y-position, meters', 'v_i(t)': 'instantaneous speed of player i, m/s', 'd_i(t)': 'distance traveled by player i, meters'}
primitives.assumptions: Players move in 2D Euclidean space; frame rate is constant; ball trajectory is interpolated linearly between frames.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When frame drops exceed 5 consecutive frames, interpolation becomes unreliable.

layer2.mapping: Maps video-derived point tracks to velocity and displacement fields used in GSE's state transition models.
layer2.telemetry: Per-frame speed deviation from expected trajectory.

primitives.name: Kinematic Model
primitives.verbatim_quote: Predicts deltas + speed + uncertainty with relational 22-player modeling and physics-informed losses.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'\\mathbf{X}_t': 'state vector at time t, (position, velocity, acceleration) × 22 players', '\\mathbf{U}_t': 'control inputs (e.g., direction, force), dimensionless', '\\epsilon_t': 'noise term, m/s²', 'f': 'nonlinear deterministic function'}
primitives.assumptions: System evolves deterministically with additive noise; 22-player interactions modeled via pairwise potentials.
primitives.breakdown_regime: High collision density (>10 collisions/frame) leads to divergence in model predictions.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to GSE's physics simulation kernel, where each player's motion is governed by Newtonian mechanics.
layer2.telemetry: Prediction variance across 100 Monte Carlo rollouts.

primitives.name: Data Pipeline
primitives.verbatim_quote: Storage discipline carried forward: **raw frames as per-play Parquet in a lake; Postgres gets derived per-play features only.** 3.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'\\mathcal{L}': 'lake storage, Parquet files', '\\mathcal{F}': 'feature store, Postgres tables', '\\text{raw}': 'per-frame data, bytes', '\\text{derived}': 'aggregated metrics, floats'}
primitives.assumptions: Raw data is immutable post-ingestion; derived features are computed once and cached.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Pipeline stalls when raw frame count exceeds 10^6 per play due to I/O bottleneck.

layer2.mapping: Enables GSI’s probabilistic forecasting by providing clean, structured inputs to downstream ML pipelines.
layer2.telemetry: Latency of feature extraction from raw frames.
